etsy.title: Christmas Activity Book Printable for Kids, 48 Pages Mazes Word Search Dot to Dot Coloring, Screen Free Holiday Activities, Ages 4-8
etsy.description:
Hours of screen-free Christmas fun, ready to print tonight.

WHAT'S INSIDE (48 pages, US Letter + A4 PDF)
• 10 Christmas mazes
• 8 word searches with holiday words
• 8 dot-to-dot pictures
• Tracing pages: MERRY, CHRISTMAS, SANTA, SNOW
• 12 coloring pages
• Draw-your-tree page and a letter to Santa
• A Christmas Champion certificate

PERFECT FOR
• Kids ages 4–8 during winter break
• Quiet time, restaurants, car rides and classroom parties
• A last-minute stocking stuffer (print, staple, done)

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Print at home or at a print shop, as many times as you need for your family.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
